title: Working next to the Z machine at Sandia

tellings.quote: I used to work uh next to the Z machine at Sandia.

plain: The physicist John Brandenburg says he used to work next to the Z machine, a very large machine for producing powerful electrical pulses, at Sandia National Laboratories, a US government lab in New Mexico. He mentions it to Michels in passing, as part of his own career, which would place him inside the national labs' work on high-energy physics.
